assumptions: start ROCE 73/350=20.857%, assumed cost of capital 12% (Part 23 estimates it), excess 8.857 points
erosion e=(1-moat)*min(1,2*cut)*(1-0.15*ads%) per war year applied to customers and excess profit alike
ads cost ads%*500/350 ROCE points per war year
lost customers do not return; capital 350 fixed; market 12,500 growing 8%; share 2.4%
five forces: weights rivalry 2.0, entrants 1.5, substitutes 1.0, buyers 2.0, suppliers 1.5 points of sales (illustrative); base EBIT margin 14.6%; ROCE=margin*500/350; need 8.4% for 12%
